prompt: How old would James Logan have been when the estate of his descendent donated Neshaminy State Park land to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania?
answer: James Logan was born on October 20, 1674. When his descendant Robert R. Logan’s estate donated the land in 1956, James Logan would have been **about 281–282 years old**—**282 if the donation occurred after October 20, 1956**.
